summary: FRONTEND-ONLY test of ORRBBIT Iter56 features: (A) Control Centre Date & Time settings and shared fmtDT usage across screens; (B) Initial Profile Setup onboarding reusing PromptsEditor with round-trip to Edit Profile. All primary flows PASS. No critical or minor issues found. Persistence, format switching, and round-trip all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: PromptsEditor is properly reused in both /(auth)/profile-setup.tsx and /edit-profile.tsx, saving to the same 'prompts' profile field — no divergence.
fmtDT is used across control screens (audit-logs, notifications delivery history, settings platform config); no raw ISO / 'GMT+10' timestamps observed in real data cells.
ControlContext persists cc_tz/cc_fmt via AsyncStorage.multiSet and rehydrates via multiGet on boot — verified working across reload + logout/relogin.

Note (unrelated to this iter, minor UX): profile-setup PUT payload sends display_name but the /auth/me response shows display_name=null after save (unset by backend serializer). Root user 'name' still displays. Out of scope for Iter56.
seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway test user via /api/auth/register (tester+vkibd7x1@example.com, DOB 1996-05-15). email_verified was flipped to true directly in mongo db.users to bypass the verify-email gate as instructed. No other data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://nearby-connect-93.preview.emergentagent.com. Control Centre login qa-admin@intro.control / Qa!hpgOlIndvj0UbVWk (rate-limited on rapid retries). frontend/.env has EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTROL_BACKEND_URL commented out on purpose so Control Centre hits the preview backend — DO NOT restore. For onboarding tests, register via POST /api/auth/register (field is 'date_of_birth', not 'dob'), then flip email_verified=true in mongo (db_name=test_database, users collection). Set auth_token in localStorage as JSON.stringify(token) before navigating.

1_control_centre_settings.notes: Date & Time card visible on /control/settings. Chips render for Australia/Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Perth, Auckland, UTC, London, NY, LA, Singapore. Format chips DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD present. Selecting Australia/Melbourne + DD-MM-YYYY updated Preview to '27-08-2026 22:38 AEST' (later 22:40 AEST on reload) — matches requested example.

2_persistence.notes: localStorage cc_tz='Australia/Melbourne', cc_fmt='DD-MM-YYYY' persisted across page reload. Clearing cc_token+cc_admin and re-logging back in preserved cc_tz/cc_fmt and Preview string ('27-08-2026 22:40 AEST').

3_shared_formatter.notes: /control/audit-logs: all When cells rendered as e.g. '27-08-2026 22:28 AEST'. /control/notifications delivery history: '25-08-2026 08:56 AEST', '23-08-2026 14:27 AEST' etc. /control/users Joined column shows date-only '17-07-2026' (fmtDT dateOnly). /control/settings platform config: 'Changed by qa-admin@intro.control · 23-08-2026 14:27 AEST'. Switching to YYYY-MM-DD and revisiting confirmed downstream screens react to the shared prefs. No raw ISO timestamps or 'GMT+10' observed in data cells (a lone '2026-06-20T09:00:00' in notifications is the placeholder text in the schedule input, not data).

4_onboarding_prompts.notes: Fresh user registered, navigated to /profile-setup. 'Conversation prompts (optional)' section renders under form. testID='add-prompt' opens picker (testID='prompt-picker') containing 10 suggestions including 'My ideal weekend is...'. Selecting an option creates prompt-card-0 with prompt-answer-0 TextInput (accepted 'Yarra walks + laneway coffee. Second answer!'). prompt-remove-0 removes the card. Re-add + answer flow works cleanly.

5_optional_non_blocking.notes: After removing prompts entirely, filling display name, city, bio (>40 chars), interests (Coffee/Tech/Music), tapping Next produced setup-error 'Please add at least 2 photos.' — proving the blocker is photos, NOT prompts. Prompts truly optional.

6_edit_profile_round_trip.notes: Saved prompts via PUT /api/users/me (prompt='My ideal weekend is...', answer='Coffee, laneways and Yarra walks.'). Loaded /edit-profile: prompt-card-0 rendered, prompt-answer-0 pre-filled with the exact saved answer, prompt title 'My ideal weekend is' visible. Same PromptsEditor component used — no data divergence.
